description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for the Signal Enrichment component in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes constants for configuration paths and methods to retrieve provider information and configurations, as well as an inner enum for known configuration values.

classes.name: SignalEnrichmentConfig
classes.description: Interface providing methods for accessing signal enrichment configuration details, including provider info and configuration rendering.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the class name of the signal enrichment facade provider.

methods.name: getProviderConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration object for the provider.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the current configuration as a Config object.

inner_classes.name: SignalEnrichmentConfigValue
inner_classes.description: Enum representing known configuration path expressions and default values.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns the default value associated with the configuration key.
